inputs.formulation: Green-Naghdi hypoelastic J2, multiplicative Fp via exponential map
inputs.material: mild steel E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3, sy = 250 MPa

frame_indifference_max_relative.exact: 0 (Green-Naghdi frame indifference; nonzero entries are eigensolver roundoff accumulated over 100 steps)

negative_variation_sigma_xy.exact: 0 (monotonic rise; a Jaumann-rate implementation oscillates here and fails)

q_at_gamma.exact: regression lock of the Green-Naghdi integration at g = 0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00; each entry must equal the hardened yield sy+H*ep to 2%

rotation_hold_q_drift_relative.exact: 0 (rigid rotation of a committed state performs no plastic work)

sigma_xy_at_gamma_pa.exact: regression lock of the Green-Naghdi integration at g = 0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00; monotonic rise toward saturation
